about: 20 synthetic incident descriptions written by team soloDolo. No real victim data. 'expect' is the correct route: a playbook label, or 'clarify' (Mgadi should ask a question first). A payment-diversion case that goes to 'clarify' is a SAFE miss (the question still ends at the bank); one that goes to any other playbook is an UNSAFE miss.
warning: The rehearsal's rule classifier was written while looking at these cases, so its score on them is optimistic. At the event, write a fresh held-out set (prep/heldout-cases.json) BEFORE tuning, and report both.

cases.text: Our supplier says they never changed bank details but we paid R70,000 to the new account they emailed us last week.
